data.description:
## Description

What: Investigation/spike (flagged medium/assumption in the epic Scenario Analysis) to capture a live Gitar Dashboard issue-comment body, document its section structure and per-row layout, and evaluate the in-place edit behavior (same github_comment_id across edits) that drives the row_content_hash dedup augmentation. Output: the documented section structure plus captured fixtures gitar-dashboard.json and gitar-dashboard-edited.json under tests/fixtures/bot-comments/. Why: the Gitar Dashboard format is unverified; the parser (draft-3) and dedup (sc-5) depend on knowing the real structure. Scope IN: capture live Dashboard body (or, if Gitar is offline, document the best-available format and mark the fixtures as synthetic-pending-verification), document section/row structure + edit behavior, commit the two Gitar fixtures. Scope OUT: the parser implementation (draft-3).


## Done Definitions

- A captured Gitar Dashboard body is committed as tests/fixtures/bot-comments/gitar-dashboard.json with its multi-section row structure documented (provenance noted: live-captured or synthetic-pending-verification) ← Satisfies: sc-5
- An edited-Dashboard fixture tests/fixtures/bot-comments/gitar-dashboard-edited.json is committed with the same github_comment_id and one added row, demonstrating the in-place edit behavior that row_content_hash dedup must handle ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations

- [Assumption] This spike de-risks the medium/assumption Gitar Dashboard format scenario from the epic's Scenario Analysis; document explicitly whether the captured body is live or synthetic-pending-verification so draft-3 can flag drift accordingly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want the live Gitar Dashboard comment format captured and documented, so that the Gitar parser's section parsing and row-hash dedup are built against verified structure rather than an assumption.
